payload.artist_html: Drawing by Michael Long, published by Christine M. Janis, Borja Figueirido, Larisa DeSantis, Stephan Lautenschlager
payload.description_html: Yvridiosuchus boutilieri (Eudes-Deslongchamps, 1868c) Johnson, Young & Brusatte, 2019. (A–D) OUMNH J.1401, holotype and (E–I) OUMNH J.29850, referred specimen. Skull in (A and E) dorsal, (B and F) ventral (palatal), (C and G) right lateral, (D and H) left lateral and (I) occipital views. Refer to abbreviations list. Scale bars: 5 cm.
